inherited_scope_note: The reused catalogue was proven on the first8 source/closed set. Source semantics are reused conditionally; actual printing/availability in these7 inputs remains unknown until natural closure.

rules.future_use: Bind full input/profile and ordered symbol+ordinal first. Compare CH/DH P0/F whole cycles; retain kernel intervals separately and reconcile their sum/residual with strict total.
rules.missing: No accepted strict identity: null, never a partial-cycle substitution.

rules.future_use: HIT+HIT_RESERVED+MISS+SECTOR_MISS, excluding RESERVATION_FAIL retries and supplementary MSHR_HIT. Valid nonnegative differences of consecutive matched print boundaries give interval totals.
rules.missing: Raw field absent at a boundary: phase not established; not zero.

rules.field: L2 all-access misses/reservation_fails and raw fail-breakdown
rules.future_use: Keep access type. Strict misses include other types such as writes; positive-only bracketed reasons need closed-sidecar parser, not invented strict fields.
rules.missing: Absence from positive-only print/strict numeric parser is not measured zero or occupancy.

rules.future_use: reads=n_rd+n_rd_L2_A, preserve write-allocation vs demand domains; consecutive print deltas only when fully observed and monotone.
rules.missing: Do not infer zero from missing controller records.

rules.future_use: Same-design/F association with cycles and traffic. It is not isolated FR-FCFS full cycles and may count40subpartitions per L2 tick.

rules.field: CH common Tag/PIB and DH OO Tag/PIB
rules.future_use: CH PAPER_BASE commonPIB256; DH PAPER_OO PIB128. Bank service tag_conflicts differs from mapping evictions. Compare within design and field source; do not treat DH genericPIB8 as active capacity.
rules.missing: OO tag-conflict/full fields not printed stay MISSING, not zero; common-field labels cannot certify identical mechanism.

rules.future_use: A declared additive difference may be grouped by exact ordinals; divide PIB integral by matching sample count and service-sum by matching retired count. Keep nonzero denominators and event class.
rules.missing: CH finite_service0 absence is not zero. Mean service delay is not critical-path application time.

rules.future_use: Use gauges for drain/conservation and peaks for whole-prefix diagnostics. Never sum/difference running maxima into per-kernel peaks.
rules.missing: Terminal0 means drained, not no queue pressure.

rules.future_use: May describe same-design/F cumulative request age when printed. Do not difference means or weight by DRAM atoms; exact per-phase mean needs compatible numerator+request denominator.

rules.future_use: Retain as explicitly limited diagnostics only. Fold/tail and distinct numerator/denominator windows preclude exact final or interval attribution by default.
rules.missing: Missing is not0; no unsourced regex/value repair.

rules.future_use: With perf_sim_memcpy1, each HtoD invokes forced L2 tag fill, not ordinary queued DRAM data transfer. Keep command placements in the kernel join and disclose persistent L2/flush contract.
